prompt: Who had the best career batting average out of every player to hit a home run in the 2002 World Series matchup between the Anaheim Angeles and San Francisco Giants?
answer:
**Barry Bonds** of the San Francisco Giants had the highest career batting average among the players who hit a home run in the 2002 World Series: **.298**.

The next-highest was Garret Anderson of the Angels, at approximately **.293**.
